ruleDefinitions.name: Modification of IE Registry Settings
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects modification of the registry settings used for Internet Explorer and other Windows components that use these settings. An attacker can abuse this registry key to add a domain to the trusted sites Zone or insert JavaScript for persistence Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Internet\\ Settings.*") AND  NOT (Details = RGX("^DWORD") OR (Details = "Cookie\:" OR Details = "Visited\:" OR Details = "\(Empty\)") OR (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Cache.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\ZoneMap.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\WpadDecision.*")) OR Details = "Binary\ Data" OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Internet\\ Settings\\\\Accepted\\ Documents.*") OR process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\RuntimeBroker\.exe")
